Subject: Request: scoped 180d session log preservation + proof-of-delete artifacts

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. Quick background: we're in the final stages of a security review and Novasafe has one product line (customer namespace NS-485) that needs session/debug retention extended to 180 days for troubleshooting + regulatory traceability. Our security team also needs a standard set of "proof-of-delete" artifacts when records are purged (hash manifest, deletion timestamp, storage shard ids).

We can do a SIG/CAIQ addendum if that helps. Specific asks: 
- Confirmation Redwood can preserve session/debug traces for NS-485 for 180 days (instead of default 30d)
- A short description of the deletion workflow and a sample proof-of-delete delivery (CSV or JSON manifest)
- Any compensating controls (access controls, narrow-scoped retention) you recommend

Target timeline: we'd like this documented by EOW so our legal team can close the review. Happy to hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Security Operations
Novasafe Therapeutics

Sam — thanks for the clear asks and the SIG packet. Looping in Kimberly and Karthik for implementation and evidence details. Quick summary of our approach below and next steps we propose.

Summary (high level)
- Scoped retention: we can enable a tenant-scoped override for NS-485 to preserve session/debug traces for 180 days. This will be configurable at the tenant level and will not affect global defaults.
- Proof-of-delete artifacts: we can deliver a manifest CSV with record ids, sha256 checksums, deletion timestamps (ISO8601), and the storage shard identifier. We can also provide a signed digest (HMAC) for tamper-evidence.

Proposed near-term deliverables (by 2026-07-30)
1) Implementation note (how the tenant-scoped override is applied and the retention window impact) — Kimberly
2) Sample proof-of-delete manifest (template CSV) and the HMAC signing process — Karthik
3) One-page legal-friendly description for your review to attach to the SIG/CAIQ addendum — Priya

Can you confirm the list of tenant IDs under NS-485 that should be in scope and whether this must apply retroactively to logs already aged 30–180 days? If retroactive, include a rough window (e.g., last 90 days).

Thanks — I'll start the runbook note and attach a draft manifest.

— Mina Haddad

Subject: Re: Request: scoped 180d session log preservation + proof-of-delete artifacts

Mina / Sam — technical details below. I'm attaching a short runbook excerpt (redwood-scoped-erase-runbook.md) and a sample manifest we'd deliver.

How the scoped retention works (concise)
- Tenant override flag: we add a tenant-level flag (retention.override_days=180) that is evaluated by the log lifecycle worker.
- Storage impact: session traces are moved to a colder shard tier after 30 days by default; the override forces retention in the warm tier for the configured period to preserve indexing/forensics. Cost delta is noted in the runbook.
- Access controls: only scoped support and security roles can request exports/purge; exports are logged with audit entries linked to the tenant id and requestor id.

Proof-of-delete specification
- Manifest columns: record_id, record_type, tenant_id, sha256_checksum, created_at, deleted_at (ISO8601), storage_shard, deletion_request_id
- Delivery channel: signed manifest over SFTP or uploaded to your shared Drive link. We will include an HMAC-SHA256 digest signed with a dedicated key stored in our KMS.
- Retention of artifacts: manifests kept 1 year for audit, accessible to authorized contacts.

Retroactivity: we can target retroactive inclusion for logs within the last 90 days. For older windows (90–180 days) we'd need to perform a cost/feasibility check; I've included an estimate in the runbook (see cost appendix).

Attachments: redwood-scoped-erase-runbook.md (markdown), sample_manifest_template.csv (csv)

Kimberly Park
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Sam — next steps and timeline below.

Agreed items
- Redwood will enable tenant-scoped retention.override_days=180 for NS-485 (non-global change).
- We will produce a sample proof-of-delete manifest (CSV) + signed HMAC digest and deliver via your Drive link.
- Retroactivity: we will include logs from the last 90 days by default. If you need up to 180 days retroactively, we'll scope the additional work and provide a cost estimate (two business days).

- Sample manifest template + example (Karthik) — 2026-07-29 EOD

I'm attaching an initial evidence_manifest.csv (template) for your legal team to preview. If approved, Priya will draft language you can append to the SIG/CAIQ responses and we can route DocuSign for a short addendum.
